data_records.name: Ephemeral realtime microphone/call audio
data_records.ai_access: only approved realtime capability providers selected by routing policy
data_records.retention: ephemeral by default; no persistent VSN storage unless recording/capture is explicitly enabled
data_records.deletion_method: memory/session teardown plus provider-specific deletion/retention controls

data_records.name: Meeting recordings and clips
data_records.retention: tenant-configurable policy required before production; default should minimize retention
data_records.deletion_method: delete primary object, derived clips and indexed references; propagate deletion to supported providers
data_records.backup_policy: encrypted backups only if retention policy explicitly permits

data_records.name: Transcripts, captions and meeting intelligence artifacts
data_records.retention: inherits tenant conversation retention policy; live provisional artifacts may be superseded by finalized versions
data_records.deletion_method: delete canonical record plus derived search/vector/cache copies
data_records.backup_policy: encrypted backup subject to retention/deletion window

data_records.name: Voice profiles, speaker embeddings and verification/deepfake signals
data_records.retention: explicit consent-bound retention; revocation must trigger deletion where technically supported
data_records.deletion_method: cryptographic/logical deletion of profile and derived identifiers plus provider deletion propagation
data_records.backup_policy: avoid backups unless recovery requirement is explicitly approved
data_records.non_production_policy: no production biometric copy to lower environments

data_records.name: Provider API credentials, OAuth tokens and signing secrets
data_records.ai_access: no model access; only authorized runtime components
data_records.deletion_method: revoke upstream where possible and delete secret material/reference
data_records.non_production_policy: separate non-production credentials; never copy production secrets

data_records.name: Tenant/user/account and participant metadata
data_records.log_policy: minimal identifiers; redact sensitive profile data
data_records.ai_access: only when required for authorized workflow context
data_records.retention: account/tenant lifecycle plus legal/business record requirements to be finalized before production

data_records.name: CRM, email, calendar, chat, documents and integration payloads
data_records.retention: minimize copies; obey source revocation and tenant integration policy
data_records.deletion_method: delete cached/indexed copies and revoke connection tokens
data_records.backup_policy: avoid unnecessary payload backups; metadata backup only where sufficient
data_records.non_production_policy: no raw production connected-app data without explicit approval

data_records.name: Billing, entitlement and usage ledger
data_records.log_policy: no raw card data; redact billing identifiers where possible
data_records.ai_access: aggregate analytics only unless explicitly required
data_records.retention: financial/accounting retention policy to be finalized by operating jurisdiction; raw card data never stored by VSN
data_records.deletion_method: retain only records legally/business-required; delete non-required personal derivatives

data_records.name: Provider routing, observability, audit and security events
data_records.log_policy: structured allowlist; no raw audio/transcript/secret content
data_records.ai_access: operational analysis only with redacted fields
data_records.retention: separate audit/security retention schedule required before production
data_records.deletion_method: policy-based expiry with protected audit exceptions where justified

data_records.name: VSN proprietary training/evaluation datasets and model artifacts
data_records.retention: dataset-specific provenance/rights policy; customer content excluded by default unless separately authorized
data_records.deletion_method: dataset lineage-aware deletion/tombstone and model-impact assessment
data_records.non_production_policy: research environment is separately controlled; production customer content is not copied by default

notes: PHASE-000 data classification baseline is defined. Retention values that depend on jurisdiction, enterprise contract or provider capability remain policy parameters and must be finalized before production release; this file does not claim legal compliance by itself.
